hooks.name: Sync dashboard types with the Pydantic schema
hooks.description: When a GhostReplay schema model changes, ask the agent to mirror the change in the dashboard's TypeScript types and type-check the dashboard.

action.prompt: A Pydantic model in packages/ghostreplay/src/ghostreplay/models/ was just changed. Compare the changed models (Event, Execution, ExecutionSummary, FaultSpec, FaultTarget, FaultPreset, Divergence, InvariantResult, Provenance, AppliedFault, ReplayAnnotation and their enums) with apps/dashboard/src/api/types.ts and update types.ts so every field name, optionality (Optional -> `T | null`), literal union and enum value matches the Python model exactly. Do not change the Python models. If a change is not backward compatible with stored ghostreplay/v1 documents, say so explicitly instead of silently bumping SCHEMA_VERSION. Then run `corepack pnpm --dir apps/dashboard typecheck` and fix any type errors in apps/dashboard/src caused by the change. Summarise which fields changed.
